mantis: Eight contiguous magnetic mel-band envelope trajectories, 79->512 linear temporal interpolation; independently encode each channel, concatenate; transformer layer 2, combined tokens; pretrained and three random seeds.
tspulse: Same eight trajectories, independently encode as channels; masks off; eight ordered adaptive-average blocks of backbone tokens, concatenate; pretrained/random42. This is frozen extraction, not TSLens fine-tuning.
fisher: Explicit LP100 magnetic mel adapter: dB power to log magnitude, published fixed normalization, native frequency-band CLS extraction. Not original audio STFT preprocessing.
fusion_ablation: Concatenate pretrained Mantis embedding and spectral-trend features before training-fold scaling; fixed same readout.
